nodes.name: Deterministic EOL & Candidate Diff
nodes.notes: Stage 1: Zero-token deterministic check for missing slugs, OpenRouter EOL metadata, and newly added same-provider candidate models.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'google/gemini-4-hydrogen:online', temperature: 0.1, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a strict LLM Model Lifecycle & Predecessor/Successor Auditor for Chatlytics.de. Given currently tracked OpenRouter models and newly discovered candidate models from the same providers, identify ONLY genuine direct version/generation successors within the SAME provider and SAME model family/tier (e.g., gpt-6-luna -> gpt-6.5-luna, claude-sonnet-5.5 -> claude-sonnet-6.0, deepseek-v4.1-flash -> deepseek-v4.2-flash). NEVER map across different tiers (e.g. never map a flash/mini model to an opus/pro flagship or vice versa). Also check via web search if any tracked model has an officially announced deprecation/EOL date. Output ONLY valid JSON: {"alerts": [{"alert_type": "successor_available" | "model_eol", "severity": "info" | "warning" | "critical", "current_model_id": "provider/model", "suggested_model_id": "provider/new-model or null", "suggested_display_name": "Provider · Model Name or null", "confidence_score": 75..100, "reason_de": "Kurze deutsche Begründung", "reason_en": "Short English reason", "source_url": "https://... or null"}]}. Omit anything with confidence_score < 75.' }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ tracked_models: $json.tracked_models.map(m => ({ id: m.id, provider: m.provider, display_name: m.display_name, presets: m.preset_names })), new_candidates_by_provider: $json.candidates_by_provider }) } ] }) }}
